run_playthrough_kuhn_poker: run the playthrough CLI to generate a random game playthrough for kuhn_poker
run_playthrough_with_actions: run the playthrough CLI with specific action choices and output to a file
run_playthrough_update_path: run the playthrough CLI to regenerate all playthroughs in a given path
run_playthrough_alsologtostdout: run the playthrough CLI with alsologtostdout to print the trace to stdout
run_playthrough_sharded: run the playthrough CLI to update playthroughs using sharded parallel processing
